postal_system.assignment_rule: Virgin Islands Postal Services is the official operator. Current government pages demonstrate live VG1110, VG1140, VG1150 and VG1160 use; the 02/2007 UPU sheet defines VG plus four digits and historically links postcodes to P.O. box or collection-office locations. Examples and search snippets are not a current complete typed assignment denominator.
postal_system.geometry_rule: Do not turn an island, district, registration section, delivery office, P.O. box, National Addressing System building, locality, point, road buffer, hull, Voronoi cell, administrative boundary or AGID cell into a postal area. A commercial catalog advertising six four-digit postcode polygons is discovery evidence only until the exact data, edition, rights, topology and redistribution/public-serving authority are fixed and reviewed.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, organization, P.O. box, street, estate or locality, island, premises, unit and VG-prefixed postcode separately. Official examples are never production address rows.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store postcode, collection office, P.O. box location, delivery route, island, locality and postal area as distinct typed objects with separate stable IDs and validity.
postal_system.building_rule: A postcode or National Addressing System label does not establish a building relation. Building display requires a separately licensed civic-address identifier, explicit building crosswalk and permitted point or footprint geometry.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Island, district, registration-section, planning and National Addressing System identities are administrative or civic context and are not postal assignments or postal polygons.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Rights-cleared assignments and eligible geometry may support reviewed derived surfaces, simplification, drift checks and AGID indexing only with input and output digests, method, timestamp, confidence, uncertainty and derived status. Models must not fill unknown coverage.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID is an independent spatial index. Crosswalks may relate versioned postal, administrative, civic-address, building and geometry IDs without relabelling an AGID cell or another source object as official BVI postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Public webpages and a commercial catalog do not grant bulk extraction, processing, redistribution or public-serving rights. The located NIQ/GfK edition is sold for in-house single-workstation use under a mandatory signed agreement; no data was purchased or accessed.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: Preserve VG identity and each source jurisdiction independently; do not merge, extend or reinterpret neighbouring territories or sovereignty.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Exclude private addresses, P.O. box users, recipients, owners, occupants, credentials, customer queries and land-right records from public artifacts.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Store assignment validity, operator observation, source edition, retrieval time, geometry reference date, generated time, digest and supersession independently.
postal_system.hugging_face_rule: Publish only rights-cleared, versioned partitions with source, terms, jurisdiction, CRS and digests; restricted commercial data and address-level records remain external or gated.

stages.definition: British Virgin Islands address-format and source inventory only.
Digest-bound current operator, VG-plus-four-digit format, rights, postal-object, geometry, address/building/administrative/AGID separation and no-proxy rules.

M2 requires a current authoritative Virgin Islands Postal Services or competent-public immutable release containing the complete finite VG postcode denominator with stable postal object IDs, every assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit area/non-area status, fixed with retrieval time, edition, schema, coverage, exact bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. Current government pages confirm live VG-prefixed use and a commercial catalog advertises six four-digit polygons, but no current complete typed public denominator or public-serving geometry rights were established and the commercial bytes were not accessed. Every drawable code must reconcile to a fixed real Polygon/MultiPolygon whose postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, edition, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions are explicit. Islands, districts, registration sections, offices, P.O. boxes, routes, localities, National Addressing System addresses or buildings, Points, buffers, hulls, interpolation, Voronoi/raster cells and AGID cells are prohibited proxies. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real VG API/app, normalize VG plus four digits, handle loading/no-match/multiple/API-failure/invalid-geometry/non-area states, fit and render translucent fill with a clear outline only for eligible real geometry, support clear/re-search and display selected code, postal object type, geometry kind, provenance class, source, reference date, confidence and separate postal, administrative, geometry, assertion, release, civic-address, building and AGID crosswalk IDs without inferring missing relations.

agid_integration.current_scope: VG format, source and policy metadata only; no real VG Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A current complete typed assignment denominator, compatible public-serving rights, immutable eligible geometry and actual VG loader/API/app/browser verification are required.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Never manufacture a VG postal polygon or a more-detailed address/building ID from islands, districts, offices, P.O. boxes, localities, administrative units, points, addresses or AGID cells.
